checks.name: Incremental permission tables migrate idempotently and main mode changes use revision CAS
Legacy main workspace import is idempotent and revocation cannot resurrect it
Canonical filesystem checks reject parent traversal hardlinks ADS and root replacement
Strict frozen requests reject renderer authorized fields and accessors
Pending approval survives reconstruction and rejection deduplicates changed call IDs
Approved operation resumes under a new generation with exactly one concurrent consumer
G3A-F01 original approved expiry fences a longer reconstructed request before real IO
Task grant approval permits repeated routine actions and active revocation aborts the operation
Unrelated grants do not invalidate a pending request and expired approvals fail closed
Grant owner/hash tampering and transaction failure preserve authority facts
Network and egress grants are independent and actual broker traffic stays at the approved endpoint
Environment diagnostics and non-sensitive configuration repair use real Grant CAS and preserve unknown fields
Independent filesystem action Grants compose and either relevant revoke fences a live operation

boundary: Real SQLite permission store/engine unit integration, synthetic current-owner callback. Production Pi and Windows paths tested separately.
